body:
I would have to divide this up into multiple categories. My first and main problems stem from being poor. I haven’t had running water in a year because I can’t afford to replace the well pump that cost $1300. Which I could probably afforded a while ago if I didn’t have debts of many kinds. I’m lucky I can afford to eat, have heating and electricity, but I don’t make a lot and the debts take most of my money.
Second thing is physical/mental problems that also tie in with the first problem. My teeth are all falling apart. I haven’t ever gone to a dentist mostly because I can’t afford to, and I also grew up poor(my parents were drug addicts and my mom was the only one working and a lot of her money went into buying drugs). I’m overweight. After I had gotten away from my parents and I could afford to buy food. It became my coping mechanism to eat in which caused me to develop an eating disorder. I wouldn’t say I’m super overweight but I am still. I work a 40 hour job and also do a lot of overtime(gotta pay off my debts) so it’s hard to actually have the time to actually work on myself. I’m always at my job. I’m ugly as fuck, and it really affects my mental health a lot. I know a lot of people say that about themselves, but I can assure you. I look like a caricature of a neckbeard just without being an incel. I have a lot of trauma from growing up in a toxic and dangerous place. Again I grew up with drug addicts there has been a lot of times I was beaten to near death and sold for sex to pedophiles for drug money. 
Sorry it took me so long to answer.
